representations.date.ecma:invalid_date: Valid dates are Timestamp. Invalid dates are records with __lash_brand=(date.ecma,invalid_date) and __lash_built. Source: lash-ext-date-ecma/src/lib.rs timestamp native and date_value.
representations.regex.ecma:reg_exp: Record with pattern Text, canonical flags Text, lastIndex Number and exact brand stamp. Native exec returns match data and next lastIndex without mutating its input. Sources: lash-ext-regex-ecma/src/functions.rs reg_exp; docs/kernel/design.md section 3.
representations.stamp: Helper-created branded records carry __lash_brand as (package, type) and __lash_built as exact constructor FunctionId bytes. Authored TypeScript template records carry only __lash_brand and have no constructor stamp. No representation compatibility across changed constructors is implied. Sources: docs/kernel/design.md section 3; lash-kernel-lib/src/brand.rs; lash-dialect-typescript/src/lower/expressions.rs.
representations.typescript:arguments: Record with properties and hidden set containing length. Source: lash-ext-ts-helpers/src/helpers/core.kernel arguments constructor.
representations.typescript:bigint: Explicit TypeScript BigInts are immutable tuples (ts.bigint, Int), created by literals, constructors, arithmetic and declared bigint inputs. Untagged incoming kernel integers have JavaScript binary64 Number semantics; host copy-out unwraps tagged BigInts as exact Ints. Sources: lash-dialect-typescript/src/lower/expressions.rs; lash-ext-ts-helpers/src/helpers/bigint.kernel; lash-ext-ts-helpers/src/helpers/core.kernel.
representations.typescript:iterator: Record with next as a ts.function token retaining the exact lifted closure and its captures. Source: lash-ext-ts-helpers/src/helpers/array.kernel iterator constructors.
representations.typescript:promise: Record initially with state pending and task absent, then a worker task handle. Await joins that task for its outcome. Source: lash-ext-ts-helpers/src/helpers/promise.kernel pending and await.
representations.typescript:regex_match: Record with items, index, input, groups; optional indices contains items and groups. Source: lash-ext-ts-helpers/src/helpers/regexp.kernel match_record.
representations.typescript:template: Record with items and raw source string lists, constructed once per tagged-template site. Sources: lash-dialect-typescript/src/lower/expressions.rs tagged templates; lash-ext-ts-helpers/src/helpers/core.kernel template consumers.
representations.url.whatwg:url: Record with state as a Text-valued record of href, origin, protocol, username, password, host, hostname, port, pathname, search and hash; searchParams is a branded url_search_params record with pairs and owner sharing that state. Source: lash-ext-url-whatwg/src/lib.rs url_type and record.
representations.url.whatwg:url_search_params: Record with pairs as ordered two-element Text lists and owner as absent or the owning URL state record. Sources: lash-ext-url-whatwg/src/lib.rs record; lash-ext-ts-helpers/src/helpers/url_search_params.kernel construct and refresh.
